title: Entangling Quantum Memories through a 420 km Long Fiber
summary: Entanglement generation between remote quantum memories is demonstrated in a regime that surpasses the repeaterless communication limit.

title: Pearl-Vortex Tunneling in Magic-Angle Twisted Graphene
summary: A Josephson junction acts as a single-vortex sensor, enabling the detection of the dynamics of individual Pearl vortices in magic-angle twisted graphene.

summary: Uniaxial strain applied to the hexagonal altermagnet isolates a single magnetic domain, revealing a sharp anomalous Hall effect and a sign reversal driven by modifications to the electronic Berry curvature.

summary: Here, the authors show how magnetic fields expose the hidden quasiband structure of 30° twisted bilayer graphene, a quasicrystal with 12-fold rotational symmetry but no translational symmetry.
